title: Where a release waits
description: One release run of orders-service, stage by stage, from the pipeline's own events in Grafana Cloud Logs, which keeps 14 days. Open it with var-build set to the run's build number.

panels.description: What this page shows, and what in it is chosen.

options.content: One release run, from the pipeline's own events. Every bar is measured. How long Approval takes is up to whoever plays the approver.

panels.title: Build #$build: time per stage
panels.description: The seconds each stage of this run took, rounded up as Slack rounds them, from events.py's events. Bars share one scale.

targets.expr: last_over_time({source="release-demo", service="orders-service"} | json | job!="tests" | build="$build" and stage="Build" and result="ok" | label_format seconds=`{{ ceil .duration_seconds }}` | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [$__range]) by (stage)
